_notes: Episode 4: original rule 'If you ever fall asleep on the last bus home'. Ghost-glow characters. cap: *bright*, !red!, {TEXT:N}.

lines.tts: If you ever fall asleep on the last bus home,
lines.cap: If you ever fall asleep on the *last* *bus* *home,*

lines.tts: and wake up when it's completely silent,
lines.cap: and wake up when it's completely !silent,!

lines.tts: don't look at the other passengers.
And don't talk to the driver.
At the fourth stop, they'll all stand up at the same time.
lines.cap: At the !fourth! stop, they'll all stand up at the !same! !time.!

lines.tts: They'll walk past you, one by one,
lines.cap: They'll walk past you, one by one,

lines.tts: and step off into the dark.
If one of them stops and whispers your name,
lines.cap: If one of them stops and !whispers! your !name,!

lines.tts: When the doors close, look at your hands.
lines.cap: When the doors close, look at your *hands.*

lines.tts: Would you have stayed on the bus? Tell me in the comments.
lines.cap: Would you have *stayed* on the bus? Tell me in the *comments.*
